row.evidence: Cypress's pricing page lists Team Authentication (SSO) only on Business and Enterprise, and the SSO docs describe Okta as "a standard SAML 2.0 integration rather than an Okta API integration"; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM on any tier. Team $67/mo ($799/yr) and Business $267/mo ($3,199/yr) are flat plan prices, 50 users each; Enterprise custom. SAML SSO (Okta, OneLogin, generic SAML) and Azure AD from Business up; SSO users are created on first sign-in as Member and the invite option is disabled, so IdP assignment acts as JIT provisioning. No user-management API; the Enterprise Data Extract API only exports reports.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: Starting at $67/month, billed annually at $799 (50 users)
plans.notes: Flat plan price with usage (test results) allowance, not per user.

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: Starting at $267/month, billed annually at $3,199 (50 users)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds the Data Extract (Enterprise Reporting) API, which exports test and usage reports, not users.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in docs.cypress.io (sitemap, llms-full.txt full-text export) or on the pricing page. IdP-driven access is via SAML/Azure AD SSO only.

limitations.text: Data Extract API (Enterprise) returns reports such as project-list and usage summaries, not users.

user_api.notes: The only documented Cypress Cloud API for organization data is the Enterprise-only Data Extract API (CSV/JSON test and usage reports via token). No user, team or role management API is documented.

okta.notes: Cypress documents a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta; no OIN listing found at okta.com/integrations/cypress/ (404).

entra.notes: Cypress documents creating an app registration in Azure (client ID/secret); no Entra gallery tutorial found.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic SAML Custom Connector (Advanced).

fallbacks.notes: SSO users are added on sign-in with the Member role; invitations go through the IdP. Azure AD setup uses an app registration (client ID/secret), not explicitly labelled OIDC.
